text:
Ava (PM): quick sync — we shipped the model routing tweak this morning and CS is seeing increased errors from a handful of customers. do we rollback or push small fixes?
Leo (Eng): saw the spike in Sentry too. error rate on mobile went from 0.8% -> 3.4% after 08:12 deploy. stacktrace points at tokenization path NPE in fallback branch.
Maya (Design): we also got 2 customer quotes about truncated responses — feels like regression on short-context flows.
Priya (CS): holding one AE call open with a customer on enterprise plan, they're nervous about user-facing truncation on key flows. they asked for ETA.
Sam (SRE): infra-wise the rollout used canary buckets: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. metrics show the jump during 50% step. if rollback, we can flip routing back to previous variant (flag) within 5m.
Ava (PM): options: 1) immediate rollback to previous routing (fast, hurts telemetry for new fix) 2) patch small NPE and push hotfix (lower customer impact if quick) 3) pause rollout at 50% and run targeted tests / replicate on staging. thoughts?
Leo (Eng): patch is small (~2 files) but needs CI and perf smoke. estimate 2-3h dev + 30m to push. rollback is trivial.
Sam (SRE): rollback buys time and prevents more customers from seeing it. low risk. if we rollback, we should still run a patch branch and validate.
Priya (CS): rollback + proactive comms would calm the AE. if patch ETA ~3h, customers prefer that.
Maya (Design): is there any UX degradation we can ship as mitigation (e.g., explicit fallback message) while we fix? small copy change could reduce confusion.
Leo (Eng): could add temporary fallback text, but main problem is NPE leading to truncation. fallback copy won't stop truncation.
Ava (PM): decision lean: rollback to previous routing now, run patch branch in parallel, re-rollout via canary after regression test and CS signoff.
Sam (SRE): agreed. I'll flip the flag and watch error rate. deploy-bot: rolling back route variant 'model-routing-v2' -> 'model-routing-v1' for customer buckets 50-100%. ETA 5m.
deploy-bot: [INFO] rollback started by Sam at 08:45 UTC.
Sam (SRE): error rate dropping already in 2m. monitoring dashboard: https://internal.redwood/observability/errors?range=30m
Leo (Eng): I'll start the patch branch: fix tokenization NPE, add unit + a small e2e that hits short-context flows. assigning to self.
Ava (PM): test plan: - unit + e2e passing - perf smoke on staging (latency <= 1.2x baseline) - run canary at 5% for 30m - CS signoff from Priya
Priya (CS): I'll prep the customer note once rollback is confirmed and loop in the AE.
Maya (Design): I'll draft a micro-copy fallback and stand by for review, but won't block rollout.
Leo (Eng): patch branch created: git/commit 1a2b3c (will paste CI link shortly).
deploy-bot: CI passed for branch 1a2b3c — tests: unit=✓, e2e=✓, perf=smoke pending.
Sam (SRE): rollback complete at 08:51 UTC. error rate back near baseline.
Ava (PM): thanks team. owners/action items: Sam -> monitor for 2h and confirm rollback stability; Leo -> patch + CI + draft canary plan; Priya -> customer comms; Maya -> micro-copy. reconvene in #product in 3h or sooner if issues. :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): noted, prepping comms now.
Leo (Eng): ETA for canary-ready build ~2.5h. will ping when ready.
Sam (SRE): setting an alert if error rate > 1.5% in next 2h.
Ava (PM): logging decision for postmortem item: add auto-rollback threshold and pre-release short-context suite. putting on next retro.
Priya (CS): Customer call updated — we told them we're rolling back and will follow up with ETA for re-rollout.
Maya (Design): micro-copy PR ready for review: https://git.internal/redwood/design/short-fallback
Leo (Eng): ready to start canary once QA gives green.
Ava (PM): great. closing thread — will post final notes in docs later.
